decisions.reason: Locates read sites, quotes the alpha.4 changelog entry with seq/eventAt/snapshotEvents replacements, and traces the undefined non-iterable throw through the crash stack.
Shows the install output proves only version-string containment of alpha.5 in ^0.1.2-alpha.2; npm compares metadata only; peer range is an author declaration, not a test.
Enumerates removed member, removed exports/module gaps, changed signatures/branded types, service topology, and behavior drift — clearly distinct classes.
Requires typecheck/cold-boot against actual target versions, peer-floor raise excluding breaking releases, and dual-cohort runtime feature detection; explains what metadata can and cannot encode.
Concrete pre-install check: compare peer floor to host version, read breaking changes in between, scratch-profile cold boot; explicitly tied to the alpha.4 Session.events edge.

caps.reason: Final conclusions affirmatively deny that peer satisfaction or silent installs prove runtime compatibility.
